name: WWE: Unreal
description: From Monday Night RAW to WrestleMania, this series goes backstage with WWE Superstars and staff as they bring the company's biggest spectacles to life.

videos.title: Episode 1: New Era
videos.overview: The road to WrestleMania begins as RAW makes its Netflix debut. Superstars John Cena, Rhea Ripley and CM Punk reflect on their careers and characters.

videos.title: Episode 2: Push
videos.overview: At the Royal Rumble, Cody Rhodes seeks to defend his Championship title — at any cost. Former Tag Team champion Jey Uso savors the solo spotlight.

videos.title: Episode 3: Worth the Wait
videos.overview: As Chelsea Green gets the title shot of her dreams, Charlotte Flair returns from injury at last. Bianca Belair seals her fate in the Elimination Chamber.

videos.title: Episode 4: Heel Turn
videos.overview: What does it take to be a heel? After The Rock makes Cody Rhodes a game-changing offer, WWE writers devise a plot twist that leaves Cena fans breathless.

videos.title: Episode 5: Wrestlemania
videos.overview: A season of shocking storylines culminates as WrestleMania 41 arrives in Sin City. But victory is no guarantee — and the stakes have never been higher.

videos.title: Episode 1: No Days Off
videos.overview: Balancing parenthood with the WWE, Seth Rollins kicks off his SummerSlam arc and Becky Lynch returns to WrestleMania. Pat McAfee drops the mic to fight.

videos.title: Episode 2: The Truth
videos.overview: Beloved Superstar R-Truth faces a harsh reality as a contract dispute casts doubt on his career. Naomi eyes a comeback — and enters her heel era.

videos.title: Episode 3: The Vision
videos.overview: Penta dazzles the crowd during his Money in the Bank debut. Seth Rollins and Paul Heyman open doors for the next generation of WWE Superstars.

videos.title: Episode 4: Performance Art
videos.overview: Triple H and the writers devise a top-secret SummerSlam reveal. An electrifying match between Iyo Sky and Rhea Ripley pushes Evolution to new heights.

videos.title: Episode 5: The Pop
videos.overview: Seth Rollins shocks the WWE Universe, Becky Lynch and Lyra Valkyria roll with the punches, and John Cena wrestles in his final SummerSlam match.

videos.title: The Why
videos.overview: As retirement looms, John Cena seeks an iconic — and explosive — exit from the ring. A new power couple threatens Seth Rollins and Becky Lynch's reign.

videos.title: The Last Time is Now
videos.overview: WWE's past, present and future collide during John Cena's farewell match. "The Vision" is compromised by injuries, forcing the writers' room to pivot.

videos.title: Rise & Rumble
videos.overview: With Seth Rollins out, the Royal Rumble rests on WWE's next generation. Oba Femi and Trick Williams make electric debuts; Liv Morgan earns a major win.

videos.title: Life Happens
videos.overview: Chicago's own CM Punk and AJ Lee push through heartbreak to dominate in the Elimination Chamber. Stephanie Vaquer recalls her long road to the WWE.

videos.title: The Grandest Stage
videos.overview: Championship titles, epic comebacks and unfinished business hang in the balance as the Superstars give it all they have for WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas.
